channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Theo Maledon | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Theo Maledon from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Sam Presti on Theo Maledon
item.description:
Sam Presti on Theo Maledon:

“He has a real serious make up. He has a natural professionalism to him. His personality is really even and I think that’s an understatement. (Laughs)”

Sam Presti on Theo Maledon, May 20, 2021. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Theo Maledon
item.description:
Daigneault on Maledon:

“He was quite advanced for a 19 year old. We’re really optimistic about him.”

Mark Daigneault on Theo Maledon, Mar 30, 2021. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Theo Maledon
item.description:
Brandon Rahbar:Mark Daigneault on Theo Maledon starting:

“Theo’s a point guard 100% but his shooting allows him to play off the ball and it helps the versatility of the team. He’s got great poise. He’s wise beyond his years. We want to make sure to discover where his ceiling is as a player.”

Mark Daigneault on Theo Maledon, Jan 30, 2021. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Al Horford, Theo Maledon
item.description:
Brandon Rahbar:Mark Daigneault on whether Al Horford and Theo Maledon practiced:

“Sticking with the protocols. Not at liberty to say. I’m just gonna leave it at that. Sorry.”

Mark Daigneault on Al Horford, Theo Maledon, Dec 10, 2020. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.
